metadata.title_cn: 胡塞武装发动袭击，沙特王储重担加重
metadata.title_en: Saudi Crown Prince's Burden Grows Heavier as Houthis Strike
metadata.dek_cn: 沙特王国正面临着诸多困境，伊朗支持的反叛武装正在加剧对该国安全的袭击。
metadata.dek_en: Kingdom is facing myriad dilemmas as Iran-backed rebels intensify attacks on the kingdom's security and
metadata.byline: BY SUMMER SAID AND GEORGI KANTCHEV

blocks.text_cn: 迪拜——沙特王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼以积极的姿态开始了新的一年。他刚刚访问了白宫，并受到了特朗普总统的热情欢迎。即使在与伊朗的战争爆发后，沙特阿拉伯的处境也相对较好：它可以通过一条绕过受阻的霍尔木兹海峡的管道出口石油。
blocks.text_en: DUBAI—Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman started the year on a high note. He'd just visited the White House where he was embraced by President Trump. Even after the war with Iran kicked off, Saudi Arabia looked relatively well positioned: It could export oil through a pipeline that bypassed the blocked Strait of Hormuz.

blocks.text_en: But the Saudis' escalating fight with Iran-backed Houthi militants in neighboring Yemen now piles new challenges on the kingdom's security and the crown prince's ambitious but already struggling plans to transform the country's oil-dependent economy.

blocks.text_cn: 周六，一枚胡塞导弹击中了沙特首都的国际机场，造成至少 12 人死亡，数百人受伤，其中许多人伤势严重。这是伊朗战争相关冲突中，针对美国或其海湾盟友造成的单次伤亡最严重的袭击。
blocks.text_en: On Saturday, a Houthi missile slammed into the Saudi capital's international airport, killing at least 12 people and injuring hundreds more, many seriously. It was the single deadliest attack on the U.S. or its Gulf allies in the conflicts related to the Iran war.

blocks.text_en: A 28-year-old Egyptian flight attendant bled to death after her arm was blown off, one of several victims to lose limbs, officials briefed on the attack said.

blocks.text_cn: 据熟悉情况的人士称，两座航站楼遭到袭击，屋顶部分坍塌。Storyful（一家视频验证机构）验证的视频显示，乘客在机场疏散时，拖着行李箱，从地面上一道血迹旁经过。Storyful 与《华尔街日报》一样，都由道琼斯公司所有。当局报告称，周日，关闭的机场再次遭到袭击，称一枚弹药在 4 号航站楼引发火灾，并造成人员受伤。
blocks.text_en: Two terminals were struck and their roofs partially collapsed, people familiar with the damage said. Video verified by Storyful, which like The Wall Street Journal is owned by Dow Jones, showed passengers rolling suitcases past a trail of blood on the floor as the airport was evacuated. Authorities reported new attacks on the shuttered airport Sunday, saying a projectile caused a fire in Terminal 4 and led to injuries.

blocks.text_cn: 就在今年夏天，沙特官员曾向记者表示，胡塞武装的情况已经得到控制。但武装分子日益激烈的袭击，他们声称这是对沙特采取的行动的回应，袭击了机场和能源设施——包括该国的主要东西部管道和炼油厂——表明南部边境的威胁正在增加。
blocks.text_en: As recently as this summer, Saudi officials briefed journalists that the Houthi situation was under control. But the militants' escalating attacks, which they say are retaliation for Saudi actions against them, have hit airports and energy facilities—including the kingdom's main east-west pipeline and refineries—showing the growing threat along the southern border.

blocks.text_en: The conflict is jeopardizing Saudi efforts to build travel and tourism into a pillar of the economy, including with a marquee international investment conference scheduled for the end of the month that looks increasingly in doubt.

blocks.text_cn: 王储如何应对这次考验，将对沙特王国以外的地区产生影响。沙特是全球科技产业和人工智能项目的重要资金来源，同时，它还为美国军队提供基地和空域通行权。
blocks.text_en: How the crown prince handles this test will have consequences beyond the kingdom. Saudi Arabia is a major source of funding for the global tech industry and artificial-intelligence projects. It also provides basing and overflight rights to the U.S. military.

blocks.text_en: Trump told reporters over the weekend that the U.S. was in communication with the Houthis but might join Saudi strikes on the militant group.

blocks.text_cn: 对利雅得的袭击——该市距离也门胡塞武装控制区约 500 英里——已将沙特首都的部分地区变成了战场，居民们在爆炸声中四处躲避。周四，一枚被拦截的弹道导弹的碎片击中了一所幼儿园和一座医疗诊所综合楼。该市金融区的工人、一些国际学校的学生和外交官被要求撤离或寻找避难所。
blocks.text_en: Attacks on Riyadh—about 500 miles from Houthi territory in Yemen—have transformed parts of the Saudi capital into a battle zone, with residents taking cover as explosions ring out across the city. Debris from an intercepted ballistic missile hit a kindergarten and a medical clinic complex Thursday. Workers in the city's financial district, students at some international schools and diplomats were ordered to evacuate or take shelter.

blocks.text_en: The 41-year-old crown prince is shuttling between palaces equipped with bunkers and is guarded by a handpicked security team, officials familiar with his movements said. His last public appearance was Tuesday.

blocks.text_en: He has few good options, said Kristian Coates Ulrichsen, a Persian Gulf expert and fellow with Rice University's Baker Institute. "Any military response risks getting drawn in deeper to an asymmetric conflict."

blocks.text_cn: 在过去十年中，这位王储投入了大量资金，用于一系列具有未来感的项目，这些项目具有极其复杂的工程要求，旨在展示沙特王国的现代化进程，并吸引投资和旅游。这些项目包括未来之城 Neom、位于利雅得的一座巨大的立方体建筑以及一座沙漠滑雪胜地。总成本高达数万亿美元——对年度预算仅约 3500 亿美元的政府而言可谓野心勃勃。
blocks.text_en: The crown prince has plowed funds over the past decade into a slate of futuristic projects with extraordinarily complex engineering requirements aimed at signaling the kingdom's modernization and drawing investment and tourism. They include the futuristic city of Neom, an enormous cube-shaped building in Riyadh and a desert ski resort. The total cost ran to the trillions of dollars—aggressive for a government with an annual budget of around $350 billion.

blocks.text_cn: 今年前两个季度，外国投资有所下降，并且远低于王储设定的 2030 年目标。不断上升的国防和基础设施成本可能会挤占用于推动经济多元化的资金。即使是沙特王国努力成为人工智能中心，现在也面临新的风险，数据中心正逐渐成为袭击目标。
blocks.text_en: Foreign investment fell in the first two quarters of the year and is running well behind the crown prince's 2030 target. Rising defense and infrastructure costs threaten to siphon away money needed for the economic diversification push. Even the kingdom's push to become an AI hub now carries new risks, with data centers emerging as targets.

blocks.text_en: The non-oil side of the country's economy was smaller in the second quarter than in the first, according to Capital Economics. The Saudi Finance Ministry now expects GDP to shrink by 3.6% in 2026.

blocks.text_cn: 今年年初，该国设法将石油通过管道输送到红海，以摆脱伊朗对霍尔木兹海峡的控制。但在7月，胡塞武装宣布对沙特阿拉伯实施海上封锁，使红海航运面临风险。9月，对东西管道的袭击直接威胁到该国从霍尔木兹海峡逃离的主要通道。
blocks.text_en: The kingdom was able earlier in the year to pump oil across the desert to the Red Sea to escape Iran's chokehold on the Strait of Hormuz. But in July, the Houthis announced a maritime blockade of Saudi Arabia, putting Red Sea shipping at risk. In September, an attack on the East-West pipeline struck at the kingdom's main escape route from Hormuz.

blocks.text_cn: 2015年，王储使沙特阿拉伯卷入了也门内战，支持该国得到国际承认的政府，与胡塞武装作战。沙特阿拉伯发动了空袭，加剧了冲突，但也招致了胡塞武装对其石油设施和包括利雅得在内的城市发动的袭击。双方陷入僵局，并在2022年达成了停火协议。
blocks.text_en: The crown prince got Saudi Arabia involved in Yemen's civil war in 2015, backing the country's internationally recognized government in a fight against the Houthis. It carried out airstrikes and inflamed the conflict, but also invited Houthi attacks on its oil facilities and cities including Riyadh. The sides fought to a stalemate and a ceasefire in 2022.

blocks.text_cn: 新一轮冲突爆发之际，王储正努力控制与伊朗的对抗。战争初期，德黑兰发动的袭击表明，海湾地区的能源设施和机场等经济资产面临风险。据了解沙特阿拉伯内部情况的人士称，沙特阿拉伯也在努力在广阔的国土上部署防空系统，并正在调动防空部队，以保护宫殿和重要的能源基础设施。这些人士表示，虽然王储支持继续对伊朗施加经济压力，但他也在指示他的顾问，要与伊朗保持外交沟通渠道畅通，并明确表示该国的意图并非对抗。
blocks.text_en: The new outbreak came as the crown prince was working to contain the confrontation with Iran. Attacks by Tehran early in the war demonstrated the risk to energy facilities and economic assets like airports across the Gulf. Saudi Arabia was also struggling to cover the vast country with air defense and was shifting batteries around to try to protect palaces and key energy infrastructure, people familiar with the kingdom's deliberations said. While supportive of continued economic pressure on Iran, the crown prince was telling his advisers to keep the diplomatic channel open with Iran and make clear the kingdom's intentions weren't confrontational, the people said.

blocks.text_en: The kingdom has called for help from its military ally Pakistan and is scouring the globe for air defenses, the people said. It is also looking to recruit foreign fighters to help its Yemeni allies, they said.

context_dossier.text_cn: 王储 2015 年主导沙特介入也门内战，支持获国际承认的政府打击胡塞武装，双方 2022 年停火。本轮冲突中，胡塞 7 月宣布对沙特实施海上封锁，9 月袭击了沙特绕行霍尔木兹海峡的东西输油管道，周六的导弹袭击造成利雅得国际机场至少 12 人死亡。王储过去十年投入数万亿美元建设 Neom 等未来项目，而政府年度预算仅约 3500 亿美元；沙特财政部预计 2026 年 GDP 将收缩 3.6%。
